_comment: file-budget-guard (DR-1339, DR-1330 D9b). Every file here is over the 1,500-line line a new file may not cross; each ceiling is its measured size on 2026-11-05 and may only go DOWN (node scripts/file-budget-guard.mjs --generate re-freezes lower). To RAISE one, edit by hand with a one-line reason here, the way scripts/monolith-budget.json records its raises. The shell (poe-financial-mvp-v28.jsx) keeps its own ratchet in monolith-budget.json and is listed here too so one guard reads the whole picture.
